$description: Rhythm/position rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py under the same id; verify_all.py checks the two lists agree. Exceptions were read off templates/templates.json's real node order (in-flow sections only).

rules.description: backdrop.webgl-scene is the first node (the fixed canvas sits behind everything).
Exactly one HERO-category node per page.
The HERO is the first in-flow node (fixed CHROME/BACKDROP nodes may precede it).
conversion.closing-cta immediately precedes chrome.footer (they share footer#FOOTER).
Two consecutive in-flow nodes should not share a category, except the real pairs below.
Two pinned scroll stages should not follow each other, except the real pair below.
At most 5 pinned scroll stages per page (the source has 5: hero, tagline, skills, VR, labels).
A node's textTone/accentColor must be allowed for its surfaceTone (tokens/llm/token-policy.json themeCombinations).
